zh.title: 加拿大航空開航9小時跨大西洋A321XLR航線 限量班次
zh.summary: 加拿大航空開航9小時跨大西洋A321XLR航線；限量班次測試窄體機舒適度
body: 加拿大航空近日正式啟航一條新的9小時不經停跨大西洋航線，投入A321XLR窄體機型營運，且班次為限量安排，這標誌著該航空公司在窄體機跨大西洋營運上進一步拓展。
依據航空資訊網站Simple Flying的報導，該航線採行過夜起飛與近9小時返程的模式，目的在測試窄體機執飛長距離航線時的乘客舒適度，同時保持全年網絡連結的完整性。
目前具體的航點城市組合與詳細班表時刻，仍有待加拿大航空後續發布官方資訊說明。

en.title: Air Canada launches 9-hour transatlantic A321XLR route with limited flights
en.summary: Air Canada launches 9-hour transatlantic A321XLR route; limited flights test narrowbody comfort
body: Air Canada has officially inaugurated a new 9-hour nonstop transatlantic route operated by the A321XLR narrowbody aircraft, with flights offered on a limited basis, marking the carrier's further expansion of narrowbody transatlantic operations.

According to aviation news site Simple Flying, the service features overnight departures and nearly nine-hour returns designed to test passenger comfort on long-haul narrowbody sectors while preserving year-round network connectivity.
The airline has not yet disclosed the specific city pairs or detailed schedule timings for the new service, which are expected to be released in due course.
